profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer: Vue.js, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, FileMaker
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer with experience developing web applications, APIs, integrations, and business systems using TypeScript, Vue, React, Node.js, FileMaker, SQL, REST APIs, Docker, and AWS.
  
Skilled at translating business requirements into technical solutions, collaborating with engineering, product, and design teams, and delivering customer-facing features and internal tooling in agile environments.
  
Seeking opportunities to build modern, scalable software.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Data Team
positions.description:
• Build interface for archival data stored in SQL using Vue.js, TypeScript, and Node.js
• Own high-volume data pipelines processing millions of records daily from diverse clients, including data cleansing, mapping, validation, and import workflows 
• Leveraging SQL databases to refactor legacy scripts, improving data pipeline performance by more than 200% and increasing system efficiency and reliability 
 • Translate user requirements into actionable technical solutions and development plans, partnering with stakeholders to deliver business-aligned outcomes
positions.insights: Skills: FileMaker · Microsoft SQL Server · Vue.js · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Application & Web Development Teams
positions.description:
Delivered a streamlined checkout experience, integrating Stripe Billing to simplify payment workflows and improve the customer experience.

Improved engineering quality by providing code reviews, technical mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing to support team growth and maintainability.

Partnered with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to transform business requirements into scalable full-stack solutions, delivering customer-facing features and internal tooling.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Stripe Billing · Docker Products · Front-End Development · Engineering Leadership · CraftCMS · Project Management · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Software Observability

positions.title: Director of Product Engineering
positions.description:
Joined as Product Manager and grew into leadership roles across product engineering, including Engineering Manager and Director of Product Engineering.

• Converted product and business requirements into technical specifications, implementation plans, and incremental deliverables while balancing scope, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability 
 
 • Built and delivered customer-facing features in collaboration with distributed engineering and support teams, improving system reliability, development efficiency, and user experience through engineering best practices
 
• Developed metrics, reporting, and data models to surface engineering performance trends and support operational and product decisions 
 
• Implemented process improvements and lightweight systems to improve project execution, coordination, and delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives 
 
• Created internal enablement mechanisms—including documentation, workflows, and reusable practices—to improve engineering efficiency and consistency
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · React.js · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · Git · FileMaker · Unix · Team Leadership · SQL

positions.title: FileMaker Developer / Administrator
positions.description:
• FileMaker: built custom benefit administration platform.
• PHP/JavaScript/REST API: created web-based slider that integrated with
FileMaker using vanilla JS, FileMaker's REST API, and PHP.
• GSuite: administered onboarding, offboarding, and general changes..
• Performed server maintenance as necessary.
positions.insights: Skills: FileMaker · WordPress · PHP · Defining Requirements · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• FileMaker: build inventory management tool for clothing retail merchant.
• PHP/HTML/CSS (WordPress): migrate old WordPress site to custom solution
on a different server. Maintain and customize new WordPress site as needed.
